async function persistSubtasks(subs: DecompositionSubtask[]) {

  const tasks = subs.map((s) => ({

    title: s.title,
    status: 'pending',
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    meta: { description: s.description },
  }));

  await saveTaskStore('.taskforge/tasks.json', {
    version: 1,
    tasks,
  });
